acceptanceCriteria: Explicit supersede recovery can close a historical archive with a recorded optional-artifact digest mismatch without rewriting predecessor bytes.
Required contract, summary, outcome, repository identity, and recovery receipt bindings remain strict; malformed, foreign, symlink, and unbound recovery records fail closed.
Recovery receipt binds the exact archive manifest identity/digest and the close decision records any quarantined integrity limitation as historical low assurance.
Regression tests cover valid quarantine, missing/foreign manifest binding, required-artifact tampering, malformed/symlink inputs, and normal valid close.
Tri-language lifecycle documentation describes the historical quarantine boundary and never claims the archive was current green evidence.
All declared Rust checks, repository governance checks, reviewed PR, merge, and exact cleanup pass.
goal: Add a fail-closed, auditable historical archive integrity recovery path, regression tests, and tri-language documentation; then use the published Runtime to close the blocked predecessor before release.
intent: Fix the Runtime recovery-close path so an explicit, identity-bound supersede can quarantine a historically inconsistent archive without rewriting immutable evidence, while retaining strict checks for required artifacts and untrusted records.
outOfScope: 修改任何历史 .ai/work-items/archive 文件、对象工程、发布验收脚本、参考源比较台账和无关架构拆分
